title: Ashbury Rewards Co-Brand Card Benefit Guide: Welcome Card Supplement
content:
## Benefit

A member whose linked co-brand card is the Ashbury Rewards Premier card and whose co-brand card points posted in the twelve months before the handling date total at least twenty thousand carries a welcome card supplement of five hundred points; a member whose linked card is the Ashbury Rewards card with card points of at least twenty thousand in those months carries two hundred and fifty points; any other member carries none. The supplement forms part of the welcome points of the stay; when the tier's welcome amount for the stay is zero, the stay receives no welcome points and carries no supplement.

The card points are the points the card issuer posts with each statement, totalled over the window. The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Benefit table

| Linked card | Co-brand card points in the twelve months | Welcome card supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 20000 or more | 500 points |
| Ashbury Rewards card | 20000 or more | 250 points |
| Either card | 19999 or fewer | None |
| No co-brand card | any | None |

## Illustration (hypothetical cardmembers)

A Gold Elite member holding the Ashbury Rewards card with statement points totalling 21400 in the window carries 250 points of card supplement; with 19800, none.
